description: Deferred tax under K-IFRS 1012 / 일반기업회계기준 22장: temporary differences × the rate expected when they reverse (default: 2026 average corporate tax rate incl. 10% local income tax for an expected tax base), deferred tax asset limited by expected future taxable income plus reversing taxable differences, deferred tax liability, change from opening net balance, total income tax expense, effective tax rate and a summary journal entry. Planning estimate; recognition is the company's and auditor's judgment.

currentTax.description: Current tax payable incl. local income tax

expectedBase.description: Expected tax base in reversal years (for the average rate, default 300,000,000)

futureIncome.description: Expected future taxable income available (omit = fully recoverable)

amount.description: Deductible difference + (incl. loss carryforward), taxable difference −

openingNet.description: Opening net deferred tax asset (liability negative)

rate.description: Rate when differences reverse (e.g. 0.209). Omit to use expectedBase

name: calculate_kr_deferred_tax
title: calculate kr deferred tax
